affected_targets: all 45 route entries under state: zero-false-null-absent
candidates.justification: The token 'null' was matched by pattern /\bnull\b/ inside the diagnostic header string 'State: zero-false-null-absent' rendered in synthetic test cards. Inspection confirms zero raw unhandled null/undefined/NaN tokens leaked from production application code.

affected_targets: all interactive controls across 45 route entries
candidates.justification: All buttons, anchor tags, and input elements across captured routes possess accessible names via text content, aria-label, or title attributes.

affected_targets: numeric metrics, badges, and position cards
candidates.justification: Zeroes render as '0', falses render with proper negative indicators, and null values render as em-dash ('—') without raw boolean/null leak.

affected_targets: all 45 route entries at min-width and 1920x1080
candidates.justification: All routes render within viewport constraints. Sub-gate viewports correctly trigger MinWidthGate overlay at 1199px/1279px.
No unhandled horizontal layout overflow detected (scrollWidth equals clientWidth on root containers at supported desktop resolutions).

affected_targets: app/globals.css token palette in dark and light themes
candidates.justification: Global design system token palette passes WCAG 2.1 AA text contrast thresholds across light and dark theme envelopes.

affected_targets: dialogs, drawers, disclosures, tabs, switches, shortcuts
candidates.justification: Interactive elements are keyboard reachable via Tab, focus rings are visible within viewport, Enter/Space/Arrow operate controls, Escape closes overlays and returns focus, and global shortcuts fire when idle and are suppressed in form inputs.
Lightweight-charts HTML5 canvas renders price bars graphically without an off-screen accessible DOM data table or ARIA text description for screen reader inspection.
Soft client-side navigation from /portfolio to /calendar retains the Portfolio @contextRail instead of mounting the root fallback rail, causing visual state discrepancy until page reload.
Soft client-side navigation from /watchlist to /settings retains the Watchlist @contextRail instead of mounting the root fallback rail, causing visual state discrepancy until page reload.
Switching sub-navigation sections within Settings resets the displayed density radio button selection because local component state initializes from default rather than persisted theme store.
Settings footer briefly displays 'Saved' confirmation even when backend API save fails or request is aborted, misleading operator on persistence outcome.
Step 2 Universe market-cap filter input label displays generic '$' without '(in $M)' indicator, while downstream option scanner expects values in millions.
